items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

ctx.x: Who was in the pit, in the show band?

In New York we had Billy Watrous, Danny Stiles and Bill Berry. Then we added like Ziggy Harrell and Roy Eldridge, and on sax we had Roger Pemberton, tenor, Shelly Gould, and Richie Kamuka. Then Richie had to figure out whether to add Zoot Sims or Al Cohn, then Jim Hall was the guitar, and he took off and we got Jim Raney or somebody like that. And Jimmy refused to play any of this rock & roll stuff for Sonny. He refused to do it. So they brought in another guy. So now we had two guitars. Chuck Wayne and Jim Hall.…
